title: The Importance of Sadaqah in Islam
excerpt: Understanding the spiritual and social benefits of giving charity in Islam.
content:
Sadaqah, derived from the Arabic word "Sidq" (truth), signifies truthful faith through charitable giving. It is a voluntary act of worship that purifies wealth and soul.

## Types of Sadaqah
1. Sadaqah Wajibah (obligatory) - includes Sadaqat al-Fitr
2. Sadaqah Mustahabb (voluntary) - any good deed
3. Sadaqah Jariyah (perpetual) - ongoing charity like building a well

## Benefits of Sadaqah
- Increases blessings in wealth
- Protects from calamities
- Purifies the soul
- Strengthens community bonds
- Earns continuous rewards

The Prophet (PBUH) said: "Charity does not decrease wealth."

At Minhaajulhudaa Charity, we facilitate various forms of Sadaqah, ensuring your contributions reach those who need them most. Visit our campaigns page to find a cause that resonates with you.

title: Volunteer Spotlight: Daud Mohammed
excerpt: Meet one of our dedicated volunteers who has been serving for over 90 days.
content:
Daud Mohammed joined Minhaajulhudaa Charity as a volunteer 90 days ago, and in that time, he has logged over 120 hours of service. As our Field Coordinator, Daud leads distribution efforts and ensures that aid reaches beneficiaries efficiently.

"I started volunteering because I wanted to give back to my community," Daud says. "What I did not expect was how much I would gain in return - the smiles, the gratitude, the sense of purpose."

Daud's dedication exemplifies the spirit of service that drives our organization. He is always the first to arrive and the last to leave during distribution events.

If you are inspired by Daud's story and want to make a difference, visit our volunteer page to see available opportunities.

title: Annual Impact Report 2025
excerpt: A comprehensive review of our achievements and impact in 2025.
content:
Alhamdulillah, 2025 was a year of significant growth and impact for Minhaajulhudaa Charity Foundation. Here are our key achievements:

## Beneficiaries Reached
- 1,250 families supported
- 45,000 meals served
- 50 orphans sponsored
- 12 water wells built
- 25 medical cases assisted
- 100 women trained

## Financial Summary
- Total raised: ₦45,000,000
- Total disbursed: ₦42,300,000
- Administrative costs: 6%

## Key Projects Completed
- Kofar Gabas Borehole Project
- Ramadan Food Distribution
- Women's Skills Training - Cohort 1
- Orphan Education Support

## Looking Ahead
In 2026, we plan to:
- Build 10 more water wells
- Sponsor 100 more orphans
- Train 200 more women
- Expand to 3 new states

We thank all our donors, volunteers, and partners for making this possible. Together, we are changing lives.
